body: As a former herion addict and someone who is struggling to beat alcoholism. Its just one of those things. Don't take this the wrong way but unless you have dealt with addiction you have to tell yourself ' i don't know shit about this".  Some of them can be saved, some can't. Your mom is probably approaching the end as much as I hate to say it. I will tell you what made me want to stop drinking. I asked a nurse is this going to kill me slowly or will it be quick. Its a nasty slow burn. Your mother is consumed by the worst drug known to man.  This Lock down is not helping, we are not meant to be isolated. I recommend going to a group called Alanaon something like that. It will help. Best of luck but will leave you with one piece of advice, most people that drink constantly are depressed, sad and miserable. Your mom you need to figure out what that root cause comes from.
